Question 1
?

The velocity v of a merry-go-round decreases at a rate that is proportional to the velocity at that moment. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the velocity at time t?

a
 dvdt=kt,k>0
b
dvdt=kv2,k>0
c
dvdt=kv,k>0
d
dvdt=−kt,k>0
e
dvdt=−kv,k>0
